g.text: CAN termination solder jumper, default OPEN

svg.text: All components together. Symbols follow PCB placement and are spaced for legibility.
All 137 nets are drawn, including power and ground. Junction dots join wires. Gaps mark crossings.
F1 on the battery PCB supplies 48 V to J1 pin 1 (VBUS). J1 pin 2 is the supply return (GND).
F2 feeds J11 pin 1 (BRAKE_PLUS). Connect the external 4.7 Ω ±5%, 300 W resistor between J11 pin 1 and J11 pin 2 (BRAKE_DRAIN).
Current tscircuit design | 4 x 820 uF / 100 V bus capacitors | TPS3431SDRBR watchdog | Engineering review
